jobs.description:
Are you ready for a high-tech challenge at a world-class electronics company? ⚡ As an assembly employee at Benchmark in Almelo, you will build state-of-the-art control cabinets that power global tech industries! Earn an average of €3,220 per month, get a full-time job with guaranteed hours, enjoy flexible day shifts, and kickstart your growth with top-tier training. Sounds like your dream job? Read on and apply today 👇

What we offer
- An impressive average wage of €3.220 per month!
- An extra 5.7% bonus for every worked hour
- Opportunities to get a permanent contract
- Travel cost reimbursement of €0.23 per kilometer!
- Free weekly kickboxing classes and fun team events
- Free internal 1-week Technical School training

Who you are
You have a passion for precision assembly, two right hands, and a keen eye for fine details. To hit the ground running at Benchmark in Almelo, you also bring the following: ✨

- You speak and understand English or Dutch fluently;
- You have your transport to reach Almelo;
- You have at least 1 year of practical experience in panel building or electrotechnics;
- You are available to work full-time for 32 to 40 hours every week from Monday to Friday;
- You have your own housing in the Netherlands;

What will you do
As an assembly employee, you play a key role in manufacturing sophisticated electrical cabinets and high-end control panels. Depending on your strengths, you might prepare tailored wiring setups in the Wire Center or assemble complete electrotechnical units in the Boxbuild and White Room departments using detailed work instructions. Your accuracy ensures that every tiny screw and component sits perfectly in place! Plus, you will start with a dedicated 1-week course at Benchmark’s Technical School to master all the required techniques and become a pro assembly employee.

Kick off your new adventure together with a group of new colleagues! Your training starts in week 45, and by week 46 you’ll be ready to make an impact on the

As a Mechanical Assembly Technician, you will work on the assembly of high-quality machines and technical systems used within the high-tech industry. From the first components to a fully operational machine, you play an important role throughout the entire build process. Together with colleagues from different technical disciplines, you ensure that every machine is assembled accurately, tested thoroughly and prepared for delivery. No project is the same: one day you may be assembling complex modules in the workshop, while the next day you may support installation or commissioning activities at a customer location. Your responsibilities include: Assembling machines, modules and technical installations. Installing and connecting mechanical and electrical components. Testing machines and checking functionality and quality. Reading and applying technical drawings and work instructions. Identifying and resolving technical issues during assembly. Contributing ideas to improve assembly processes. Working closely with colleagues to successfully complete projects. Arbeidsvoorwaarden You will join an innovative organization where technology, craftsmanship and personal development are key. You will work on challenging projects within high-tech machine building and have the opportunity to continuously expand your technical skills. We offer: A competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. 25 vacation days and additional ADV days. A solid pension scheme. Travel allowance. Training opportunities and possibilities for professional growth. Working with modern tools and the latest technologies. A collaborative working environment with skilled and enthusiastic colleagues. The opportunity for a permanent contract after a successful probation period. Functie-eisen You are a technically skilled professional who enjoys building advanced machines and solving technical challenges. You work accurately, take responsibility for your work and enjoy collaborating with others to

deliver high-quality solutions. You have: A technical MBO-level education, preferably in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a similar field. Experience as a Mechanical Assembly Technician, Machine Builder or in a similar technical role. Experience reading technical drawings. Strong mechanical skills; electrical knowledge is an advantage. A structured and quality-focused approach to your work. Good command of the Dutch and/or English language. A proactive attitude and a team-oriented mindset. Hier kom je te werken Through us, you will join an innovative organization active in high-tech machine building. The company develops, builds and delivers advanced machines and technical systems for leading companies within the technology industry. You will work in a modern environment where craftsmanship, innovation and collaboration come together. There is plenty of room for personal development, and you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects where you can see the direct impact of your work.
